title: The Blockwise Alperin Weight Conjecture

abstractEnglish: We prove the numerical blockwise Alperin weight conjecture for every finite group and every prime p. For each p-block B, the number of irreducible Brauer characters in B equals the number of conjugacy classes of B-weights.
